adult_predictor.name: A_pre
adult_predictor.definition: maximum adult-male individualCount among valid chorus events at the same locationID and calendar year with eventDate <= downstream eventDate
adult_predictor.rationale: preserves temporal order and avoids summing repeated counts of the same seasonal breeding population

effort_rule.if_nonempty_coverage_ge_0_80: use log(number_of_sweeps) as fixed exposure offset
effort_rule.if_nonempty_coverage_lt_0_80: Meetnetten confirmatory count model fails structural gate; do not replace with uncalibrated binary absence model

calendar_time.primary: calendar year as centered fixed effect
calendar_time.sensitivity: year random intercept only if >=5 years represented after complete-case structural filtering

habitat_modifier_priority.required_structural_variation: both TRUE and FALSE represented in >=20 exact Hyla location-years with valid effort
both TRUE and FALSE represented in >=20 exact Hyla location-years with valid effort
at least two prespecified publisher levels each represented in >=20 exact Hyla location-years with valid effort
at least two publisher depth classes each represented in >=20 exact Hyla location-years with valid effort

modifier_selection_rule: use the first variable in priority order that passes its structural variation gate; selection cannot use larval counts or effect estimates
primary_estimand: interaction between z_log1p_A_pre and the first structurally qualified habitat modifier on expected larval count per sweep

interpretation.positive_baseline_slope: greater observed adult breeding effort is associated with greater downstream larval production under the reference habitat state

sensitivity_set: replace adult maximum with mean of valid prior chorus counts
exclude downstream events occurring before the second chorus visit
fit zero-inflated negative binomial only if posterior predictive / residual diagnostics show excess zeros; not selected by p-value
aggregate to one downstream event per location-year using the earliest valid June-mid-July event as a sensitivity analysis
multiplicity_policy: only the structurally selected first habitat modifier is confirmatory; remaining modifier interactions are secondary and reported without winner-picking
